comments.body:
> use the consistent attributeName for parameter instead of facetName

Not sure about this one, we need to discuss it first I feel.

`facetName` was chosen for all widgets doing **faceting** while attributeName is more for numeric filters. It's only a way to map our users mind to the information they will find in the algolia dashboard (refinement list requirement: use attributes for faceting).

Still, we can change it maybe but it needs to be in another issue/discussion/PR I think.
Oh sorry I remembered a discussion about that, and acted as I understood it. No biggie will fix that :)

> Oh sorry I remembered a discussion about that, and acted as I understood it. No biggie will fix that :)

It is still a discussion we can have, maybe that's not good what we did but should be ok for a first release I guess
I have mixed feelings about the attributeName stuff. I acted on my own here, so I guess I should revert that anyway.
@vvo are we good to go now?
very nice to have this for 1.0.0! I would love a lib that give me so much detail about what I did wrong without me having to go to the doc, again
